sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics

The game's core mechanics are centered around your shield, which can be destroyed by the insects. When your shield is destroyed, you'll lose a life, and if you run out of lives, the game is over. The insects will keep coming until you're left with nothing but a pile of dead bugs and a badly damaged tree. Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of Insect Intruders are simple yet addictive. The game is easy to pick up, but difficult to master, making it perfect for players of all ages and skill levels.
